messages:
alex: Quick sync on APAC microburst plan. Customers want short, guaranteed bursts with predictable billing and bounded preemption.

maya: Clarify: baseline reservation + a short soft-burst window that prefers not to evict tenants for <30s bursts?

kevin: Exactly. Target = 2x baseline for spikes up to 30s. Prefer borrowable credits model but beware billing complexity.

liz: Ops questions: (1) preempt ordering across dedicated vs micro-pool best-effort, (2) how spilled requests are billed during GA.

alex: Proposal: preempt order = dedicated -> micro best-effort -> hosted. For GA, keep billing simple: spilled usage billed at reserved rate (no hosted premium), but expose a billing_mode flag for later.

maya: Suggest we model runtime policy in a small proto so teams can simulate. Draft snippet: 
```
soft_burst {
  baseline_qps: 100
  burst_multiplier: 2.0
  window_s: 30
  preempt_protection: false
  spill_action: SPILL_TO_HOSTED
  billing_mode: RESERVED_RATE
}
```

kevin: Add per-tenant toggle preempt_protection=true as paid opt-in. Also we need metrics hooks: spill_tokens, evictions, p99_latency.

liz: Ops needs burst shape (arrival rate over time) not just multiplier. @ops-bot can analytics produce 95/99th percentile burst profiles for pilot tenants?

ops-bot: Created job `burst_shape_apac` for tenants tagged `microburst-pilot`. Daily digest will post to #eng-runtime.

alex: Launch criteria: (1) proto + unit/integration tests verifying preempt order and spill, (2) APAC canary with 3 pilot tenants for 14 days, (3) dashboards for spill/cost/evictions, (4) runbook with manual drain + TTL override.

maya: MVP = behavior-first, billing toggle OFF for GA. Billing changes after stable telemetry.

kevin: I'll own canary plan and tests. Include synthetic loads to validate ordering and fairness under concurrent bursts.

liz: I'll own runbook and autoscaler knobs. Ops wants a manual soft-window extender and emergency TTL override. Add cost guardrails for pilot tenants.

alex: Action owners set: maya = proto + product doc draft, kevin = canary + test harness, liz = runbook + ops toggles. I'll draft SLA wording and book 30m sign-off Friday. If no objections by EOD I'll lock scope. :thumbsup:
